analysis:
Test-only change in provider-swift/Tests/ProviderCoreTests/Service/LaunchAgentRestartTests.swift.

Head line 2 adds `@testable import MLXLLM`. Head lines 236-258 add forwardsGDNPromptKernelRollbackToProviderJob. The test asserts that GatedDeltaPrefill.envFlag is in LaunchAgent.inferencePassthroughEnvKeys and is not in WatchdogAgent.passthroughEnvKeys. It also asserts that an unrelated secret is excluded from the plist EnvironmentVariables. Finally, it checks that the launchd-resolved mode matches the foreground mode for several values, and that "0" yields .stock.

This implies a production change elsewhere in the PR: the GDN prompt-kernel env key was added to the LaunchAgent inference passthrough allowlist. That source is not in this batch.

Security relevance is limited. The env var is operator-controlled and the operator is already in TB-003. It is an inference performance/kernel selection knob, not an attestation, authorization, or encryption control. The allowlist still excludes unrelated variables, which the test asserts at head line 251. No regression to T-041 cache controls, TB-011 authorization, or the A-001/A-003 key paths is evident.

Open question for integration: confirm in LaunchAgent.swift that only this key was added to the allowlist. Also confirm that GatedDeltaPrefill.Mode parsing in the MLXLLM SDK fails to a bit-exact kernel on malformed input. Bit-exactness affects output correctness (T-007/T-027-adjacent) but is not a confidentiality issue.

No findings.
